# stripe_metronome_customer_commit (Resource)

A customer-scoped Metronome commit. Import as customer_id/commit_id. Destroy archives remaining balance.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `access_schedule` (Attributes) ScheduleDurationInput from the pinned OpenAPI specification. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--access_schedule))
- `commit_type` (String) PREPAID or POSTPAID. This resource supports one-time access; invoiced commits require the generated createCustomerCommit action until invoice schedule fields are modeled.
- `customer_id` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `priority` (Number) Lower priority balances are spent first.
- `product_id` (String) Fixed product used for this balance.

### Optional

- `applicable_product_ids` (Set of String) Products this balance applies to. Omit to use the API default of all products.
- `deletion_protection` (Boolean) Set false and apply before archiving. Archiving removes remaining spendable balance.
- `uniqueness_key` (String) Stable Metronome idempotency key; required for new balances. Imported balances without a key can leave it null.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

<a id="nestedatt--access_schedule"></a>
### Nested Schema for `access_schedule`

Required:

- `access_type` (String) SPEND or QUANTITY.
- `credit_type_id` (String) Pricing unit ID for this balance.
- `schedule_items` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--access_schedule--schedule_items))

<a id="nestedatt--access_schedule--schedule_items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `access_schedule.schedule_items`

Required:

- `amount` (Number)
- `ending_before` (String) RFC 3339 exclusive end.
- `starting_at` (String) RFC 3339 inclusive start.
